messages:
Maya: Thanks everyone — quick post-all-hands follow-up thread for links, unanswered q's, and action items. Recording + slides: https://go.redwood.ai/all-hands/2026-03-20 :link:
Maya: TL;DR of exec Qs we didn't get to: Dedicated pricing floor, Private deployment timeline, and support SLAs. I pasted the specific clarifications below.
Priya: Quick note on Dedicated pricing — we are piloting a new per-GPU commit option. Will publish the draft pricing doc by EOD Friday. Link will be in the roadmap channel.
Jorge: Private deployment ETA: beta for VPC package targeted mid-May. On-prem (air-gapped) planned for Q3. Will open a public issue in eng-runtime tracking this.
Samira: SLA clarification: enterprise SLAs (uptime + latency tiers) are available for Dedicated contracts. For Hosted, we will publish SLOs next week and explain fallbacks in the Console doc.
Maya: Action items I/O:
- Priya: publish pricing draft (due Fri)
- Jorge: open eng-runtime issue + add rough infra checklist (due Tue)
- Lia: coordinate enterprise sales + legal to prepare an SLA one-pager (due Mon)
- Ops: share canary rollout playbook in the docs channel (ops owners, please ack)
Lia: I'm on the SLA one-pager — pinged legal, will loop in sales and post a first draft tomorrow.
Jorge: ACKed — creating issue now: https://git.redwood.ai/eng-runtime/issues/2145 :white_check_mark:
Priya: Also clarifying roadmap question from the Q&A: we will prioritize latency optimizations for 8k seqs in next sprint, then 16k. More details in the perf plan doc: https://go.redwood.ai/docs/perf-plan
Maya: Unanswered Q from Slack during meeting about telemetry retention — we plan to make retention configurable per workspace; default stays 90 days. Support for longer retention is an add-on.
Samira: Finance note: pricing experiments won't be rolled out until we have concrete per-commit simulations; we'll share sample bill estimates with the pilot customers.
Ari: Thanks — appreciate the follow-ups. Two asks from exec team: (1) add a colored status label to each action item (blocked/in-progress/done), (2) include owner email in the issue templates.
Maya: Good asks — we'll add labels and owner emails to the templates. Lia will coordinate the labels.
Lia: will do labels + will publish owner email format in the issue template by EOD Tue.
DeployBot: Deploy completed: canary/console-playbook v1.2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-20T15:02:41Z :rocket:
Priya: One clarification on canaries: the Console will show per-route rollback buttons in the next UI patch. Sharing a mock in #product-design tomorrow.
Maya: If anyone has follow-ups that weren't captured, drop them here. I'll update the action-item tracker and ping owners daily until closed. :spiral_calendar:
